summary: Confirmed the T020 acceptance contract is satisfied by the existing implementation at the approved base (feef295) with no code changes required for attempt 1. The bounded read-only RPC adapter in src/robinhood_lp/rpc/adapter.py delivers every named deliverable: bounded eth_getLogs with adaptive halving splits, block/header/receipt (eth_getBlockByNumber returning the hydrated block+header and eth_getTransactionReceipt), block-pinned eth_call (params carry both call object and explicit block tag), configurable per-request timeout (request_timeout_seconds enforced via asyncio.wait_for in _call_single), classified retries with full-jitter exponential backoff (TransportError and _TransientResponseError on -32603 retry; RpcProtocolError and non-transient RpcResponseError do NOT retry; eth_call, eth_chainId, eth_getCode are in NON_RETRYABLE_METHODS), endpoint failover across a weighted alias list (RpcEndpoint.weight, disabled=-1, stable sort in RpcConfig.active_endpoints), capability probe per endpoint that surfaces errors per-endpoint without aborting (capability_probe), and redacted metrics (RpcMetrics carries counts only; _redact_url strips user:password@ from any URL before logging). The 'must not' rules are enforced by construction: ALLOWED_METHODS frozenset rejects any method outside the bounded surface; every eth_getLogs call carries its own fromBlock/toBlock (no remote filter state); retry is bounded by retry_limit; logging uses ep.name only, never the URL or credentials (verified by test_endpoint_credentials_never_appear_in_logs using a URL with embedded user:password@). The 28 mocked tests in tests/test_rpc_adapter.py cover the entire T020 acceptance matrix: 429 / 5xx / timeout retried with backoff (test_429_is_retried_then_succeeds, test_5xx_is_retried_then_succeeds, test_asyncio_timeout_is_retried); malformed/partial responses not retried (test_malformed_json_does_not_retry, test_response_with_both_error_and_result_does_not_retry, test_non_transient_rpc_error_does_not_retry); duplicate/out-of-order logs deduplicated and sorted by (blockNumber, transactionIndex, logIndex) (test_logs_are_sorted_and_duplicates_dropped); inconsistent heads surfaced per-endpoint (test_capability_probe_surfaces_per_endpoint_results, test_capability_probe_does_not_failover_on_error, plus 7 chain_capability tests that use the adapter end-to-end); single-block oversize failure raised with a clear error (test_single_block_oversize_raises_clear_error); retry exhaustion fails over then raises RpcRetryExhausted (test_retry_exhausted_fails_over_to_next_endpoint, test_all_endpoints_fail_raises_retry_exhausted); no retry of non-idempotent/invalid requests (test_eth_call_is_not_retried_on_5xx proves eth_call never retries a TransportError; the non-retryable methods set also covers eth_chainId and eth_getCode). T002 (locked deps) and T011 (typed config) are both APPROVED in todo/config.yaml, so the 'dependency' leg of the contract status note is closed. The 'full-quality verification' leg is closed by running pytest, ruff check, ruff format --check, and mypy src tests twice each with byte-identical clean output. Per the task instructions, no commit was produced for this attempt.
